toolingCorrections: tools/check_glossary.mjs caught one map/reference collision before apply: arg226@1377 -> splitParam clashed with the wall splitting section's value178@1395 splitParam ("the file already binds or references "splitParam" for something else"). Renamed to nextSplitParam, which is what the cursor actually advances through.

tools/check_glossary.mjs must be run with --applied once a batch has been applied: without it the checker resolves map keys against the post-apply tree, where the old keys no longer exist, and reports errors=301 (every entry) plus warnings=301. With --applied it reads the batch rollback copy and reports errors=0 warnings=303, which is what this sidecar records.
